summary: Traction Financial is a Subiaco WA firm of Chartered Accountants, a Xero Gold Champion and MYOB Partner, started in 2018. Lauren Bushby is co-founder, COO and CFO and leads digital transformation; the firm sells virtual CFO packages with monthly performance reports. Its bookkeeping lead says she wants to replace repetitive bookkeeping tasks with apps.
